facts.fact: UMANG has a National Scholarship Portal (NSP) service page at https://web.umang.gov.in/landing/department/national-scholarship-portal.html (opens, HTTP 200)
facts.quote: National Scholarship Portal To ensure timely disbursement of Scholarships to students, provide a common portal for various Scholarships schemes of Central and State Governments.

facts.fact: On UMANG, students can apply for fresh NSP scholarship schemes (Centre, State, UGC, AICTE) through the 'Apply For Scholarship' service
facts.quote: Apply For Scholarship User can apply for the fresh Scheme with National Scholarship Portal - NSP published by Centre, State, UGC and AICTE.

facts.fact: NSP's own website is https://scholarships.gov.in/ (helpdesk helpdesk@nsp.gov.in, 0120 6619540)

behaviour: Gives the UMANG link from the catalogue that opens the National Scholarship Portal service on web and app (the public UMANG NSP page); if it is not listed, gives scholarships.gov.in. The link must open (HTTP 200).
fail_if: Gives no link, a link that does not open, an invented UMANG URL, or a third-party site.
summary: Added: UMANG NSP page (web.umang.gov.in/landing/department/national-scholarship-portal.html, HTTP 200) with its Apply For Scholarship service and scholarships.gov.in as NSP's site; the web_new service deep link only shows the UMANG login.
